title: Ex-Speaker Velasco still abroad after skipping NBI invite

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco is still out of the country, according to the Bureau of Immigration (BI) on Monday. The BI confirmed this to the INQUIRER after Velasco and his wife, Rowena, failed to appear before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) in response to invitation letters sent to them over the “cash delivery” claims made by the ex-Speaker’s former security aide, dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. The Velasco couple were represented at the NBI by their three legal counsels.
